reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate integration
reauth_confirm.description: i-DE rejected the stored credentials for {username}. Enter the current password.

backfill_historical_consumption.name: Backfill historical consumption
backfill_historical_consumption.description: Downloads hourly consumption from i-DE for a date range and rewrites the statistics of the Historical Consumption sensors (total and P1/P2/P3), recomputing cumulative sums. Requests are sequential (7 days each); a full year takes a couple of minutes.

start.name: Start date
start.description: First day to download (i-DE keeps about two years).

end.name: End date
end.description: Last day to download. Defaults to today.
